desc: Whether you are competing against others or just your own score sheet, the Maxus II Sporting is a clay crusher that is built to help you emerge the winner. This top contender represents the epitome of a Browning semi-auto target gun with the PowerDrive Gas System makes the gun both comfortable and reliable to shoot all day long. Total Barrel Dynamics optimizes pattern density and let's you easily swap choke tubes for tricky target presentations. An adjustable comb makes it easy to dial-in the perfect fit for every shooter.
